angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 3,357,558 km at 131.64 pc = 0.34 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 7.5965 +/- 0.0179 mas (same row, RUWE 1.01): 131.64 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 4.826 (4.729 to 4.924) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source): 3,357,558 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.660 (1.610 to 1.700) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5014 +/- 6.6 K from Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 4893980371818915456: teff_gspphot 5014.146 K (16th-84th percentiles 5007.2827-5020.536), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 4893980371818915456: teff_gspphot 5014.146 K (16th-84th percentiles 5007.2827-5020.536), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/mouhoun.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 3.291, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 30856 (pscomppars): spectral type K0 III, from Michigan Catalog, Vol. 4 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/1988MSS...C04....0H/abstract)
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 30856 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] -0.06 dex, from Johnson et al. 2011 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2011ApJS..197...26J/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 30856 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.99564, from Johnson et al. 2011 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2011ApJS..197...26J/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 30856 (pscomppars): age 3.8 Gyr, from Johnson et al. 2011 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2011ApJS..197...26J/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 30856 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 2.85 km/s, from Johnson et al. 2011 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2011ApJS..197...26J/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from a blackbody at the star's published temperature (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
